creator: Alexander Terp
description: `streams::a_closed_pane_lets_go_of_its_terminal_even_when_its_bridge_has_stopped_reading` failed once alone at load 27, then passed 3/3. Its flooding program traps HUP; at nice 10 and starved past the 3 s grace it is killed before it writes `done`, which the test reads the same as a terminal that was never let go. The test should distinguish the two (for example, check the program's exit or the terminal's state directly) so a load flake and a real leak look different.
title: A closed-pane test cannot tell a killed program from a held terminal
